Primary request: color image 1 faithfully as an elegant museum architectural illustration. This is a ruin: preserve every broken wall and the central niche, no roof or invented reconstruction. Thin charcoal outlines remain visible, restrained flat pigment planes, light natural texture only inside the solid monument; no dramatic lighting, no cast shadow. Composition: retain image 1 framing and aspect ratio. Entire outside background and truly open holes must be flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF, absolutely no black ground, gray haze, gradient, paper texture, glow, checkerboard or transparency. No people, labels, readable inscriptions, added buildings or landscape. This is a colorization, do not redesign the object.
